title: Phase 7 – Ghost Goblin Chieftain & Puzzle Vaults

systems.name: 7.1 NPC Dialogue & Quest System
systems.notes: Introduces the Ghost Goblin Chieftain NPC and a quest management system. Quests are shared per world (co-op). Dialogue UI uses procedural brass panels. Blueprint rewards tie into Tub's forge (Phase 4).

tasks.notes: Host-authoritative; sync quest states to all clients.
Multiple choice responses; character portrait possible.

tasks.text: Fetch/repair quests; grant blueprints or items on completion
tasks.notes: Quests involve retrieving items or activating ancient machinery.

systems.name: 7.2 Environmental Puzzle Controller
systems.notes: Puzzle vaults sealed by the Chieftain. No combat — each puzzle uses existing hazard and building mechanics in creative ways. Failure costs resources or teleports the team out; puzzles reset.

tasks.text: Crystal Heart: drilling sequence, pressure gauges
tasks.notes: Precision drilling puzzle; gauges show stress; must keep balance.

tasks.text: Furnace Bellows: lava flow redirect puzzle
tasks.notes: Use block placement and steam vents to guide lava to the correct channels.

tasks.text: Mirror Maze: dark/light zones, suit lamp interaction
tasks.notes: Suit lamps create safe paths; staying in darkness drains fuel rapidly.

tasks.text: Failure: resource loss or teleport, puzzle resets
tasks.notes: Never a game over; team can retry after recovering.

systems.name: 7.3 Flag Planting Milestone
systems.notes: Players plant a flag on claimed sky-castles. Acts as a permanent visual trophy and fast-travel point. Host tracks which islands are claimed.

tasks.notes: Uses custom flag model; snaps to specific pedestal locations.

tasks.text: Host tracks claimed islands, visual team colour
tasks.notes: Flag colour reflects the team who claimed it.
